description: This Java source file defines the class MqttContext, which encapsulates relevant information required during the processing of an MQTT message within the Eclipse Hono project. It provides methods to create instances from MQTT publish and connect packets, getters and setters for message metadata, and utility functions related to MQTT message handling.

classes.name: MqttContext
classes.description: A dictionary of relevant information during MQTT message processing, including message details, device endpoint, authenticated device, topic, content type, timing metrics, endpoint type, and property bag. Provides factory methods for instantiation and various getters and setters.

methods.name: fromPublishPacket
methods.description: Creates a new MqttContext instance from an MQTT publish message and device endpoint, optionally with an authenticated device.

methods.name: fromConnectPacket
methods.description: Creates a new MqttContext instance for an MQTT connection attempt.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Returns the MQTT publish message stored in the context.

methods.name: deviceEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the MQTT endpoint associated with the message.

methods.name: authenticatedDevice
methods.description: Returns the authenticated device information, if available.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Gets the message payload content type.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the message payload content type.

methods.name: topic
methods.description: Returns the resource identifier for the MQTT topic.

methods.name: tenant
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant ID associated with either the authenticated device or the topic.

methods.name: propertyBag
methods.description: Retrieves the property bag parsed from the topic, if any.

methods.name: endpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint type derived from the topic.

methods.name: isAtLeastOnce
methods.description: Indicates whether the message was published with QoS 1 (at least once).

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Sends a PUBACK message to acknowledge QoS 1 delivery.

methods.name: setTimer
methods.description: Sets a timer object for measuring processing duration.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Retrieves the timer object used for processing duration measurement.
